title: Timgad
summary: Timgad lies on the northern slopes of the Aurès mountains in Algeria. The Emperor Trajan founded it in AD 100 as a military colony for army veterans, on a square grid of streets organised around two main routes, and UNESCO regards it as an excellent example of Roman town planning.

uncertainty.note: Founding year as given by UNESCO and the University of Notre Dame record.

as_recorded.value: created ex nihilo as a military colony by the Emperor Trajan in AD 100
Founded by Trajan in AD 100 as a colony for army veterans
